name: Henry
summary: Warm monochrome editorial broadside style with cream Paper, warm Ink, massive Louize and Manuka display type, tight Neue Montreal UI text, 12px-only radius, full-bleed section inversions, no accents, and no shadows.

typography.ui_body_fallback: Inter, Sohne, General Sans, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.display_serif_fallback: Fraunces, GT Sectra, Lyon Display, Georgia, serif

layout.composition: full-bleed Paper and Ink editorial bands with type-led hero, ticker strips, and halftone plate imagery

do: Use Louize Display at 77px or larger for section-defining headlines.
Use Neue Montreal for UI and body with tight negative tracking.
Alternate Paper and Ink as full-bleed bands.
Use Manuka only for very large mastheads.
Let most of the page remain empty Paper or Ink.
dont: Do not introduce chromatic accent colors.
Do not create filled colored CTAs.
Do not use shadows, glow, gradients, blur, or elevation.
Do not use oversized Louize Display for long body copy.
Do not use any radius other than 12px.
Do not break the Paper/Ink binary with gray panels or tinted sections.
Do not center-align Neue Montreal body copy.
